messages:
AlexM: Heads-up — product asked for a new set of routing dashboards that need runtime+infra inputs. We need per-route routing decisions, fallback counts, model-variant switches, and latency breakdowns by stage. Who owns the exporters/raw stream?
Priya: I can help define the schema. Do we want Prometheus metrics for low-cardinality stuff and Kafka events for high-cardinality traces?
JonL: yes — Prom for p50/p95/total-requests per route, but fallbacks and per-tenant model_variant_id have high cardinality so push as structured events to Kafka.
SaraO: For Console UX we want: per-route QPS, success rate, fallback rate, avg latency (router + runtime + model). Also ability to compare model variants side-by-side.
ChrisR: Implementation notes: runtime already emits basic prom counters (requests_total, request_errors_total). Adding route_id label will blow up cardinality. We should only label by route_name (small set) and model_family, not full model_version hash.
EmilyA: For backfills — we need at least 30 days raw events in hot storage for re-computing baseline metrics and model regressions. Can infra afford Kafka+long retention?
Priya: Proposal: runtime emits two things: 1) Prom metrics (route_name, environment) for live dashboards; 2) structured telemetry events -> Kafka topic telemetry.events with fields: route_name, model_variant, event_type, timestamp, latency_ms, tenant_tier (enterprise/standard), fallback_reason, trace_id. Keep tenant_id hashed for privacy.
AlexM: @Priya can you paste a minimal example JSON event we expect?
Priya: Sure:
```
{
  "route_name": "chat-completions",
  "model_variant": "llama-3-8b-q8",
  "event_type": "request_complete",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T14:00:23Z",
  "latency_ms": 142,
  "stages": {"router": 10, "runtime": 12, "model": 120},
  "fallback": false,
  "fallback_reason": null,
  "tenant_hash": "sha256:...",
  "trace_id": "abcd1234"
}
```
JonL: That looks good. Two comments: 1) stages as nested object — ok for Kafka JSON, but aggregation jobs will need to parse it; 2) keep event_type set so we can send request_start/request_complete/partial_fallback.
ChrisR: Aggregation jobs: we should run a daily batch that consumes telemetry.events -> aggregates per route_name/model_variant/tenant_tier: counts, p50/p95 from histograms (we can store latency_ms samples and compute online approximate quantiles). Store results in metrics-store (timeseries DB) with 1m resolution for 90 days and 1h resolution for 1y.
SaraO: For Console retention UX: show 90d by default, allow 1y for enterprise. For backfills, product might ask for 180d — is that feasible?
EmilyA: Backfill cost: reprocessing 180d of events will be heavy. Suggest hot 30d raw events, 90d aggregates, and an on-demand ad-hoc backfill path that runs a Spark job against the cold S3 archive (if customer requests 180d we run a backfill quote).
Priya: Agree. Also recommend we avoid high-cardinality labels in Prometheus: do not add trace_id or tenant_hash as labels. Only route_name, env, model_family.
AlexM: What about histograms in Prom? Prom histograms are ok but with dynamic buckets we might want to record summary in events and compute quantiles offline.
JonL: Runtime will emit latency distribution buckets for small fixed set of routes. But for accurate p95 per model_variant we should compute from events (Kafka) — less lossy.
ChrisR: Storage plan: raw events -> Kafka -> S3 (gzipped JSON) with 30d retention in Kafka, 1y in S3 cold. Aggregator job (daily) reads last 24h from Kafka+S3 if needed and writes consolidated metrics to Timescale (metrics-store). Rollups for 1h resolution stored as materialized tables.
EmilyA: We need cost estimates. Can infra put a rough ingest QPS cap for telemetry to budget? If route emits full stages per request we could multiply tokens->events rate.
Priya: We can sample 1/1 for enterprise routes and sample 1/10 for low-tier, and always emit Prom counters. That helps controlling volume. Mark sample_rate field in event.
AlexM: Actions: 1) Priya — finalize telemetry event schema and sampling rules (due Tue). 2) Chris — build aggregator job outline + storage schema (due Thu). 3) Jon — runtime changes: kafka producer + prom label changes + sampling toggle (PR by end of week). 4) Emily — cost estimate for Kafka + S3 + compute (ETA Thu). 5) Sara — wireframes for Console showing per-route/per-variant comparisons (mock by Wed).
ChrisR: I'll repo an example Spark job skeleton and a SQL schema for Timescale. Will also include a backfill script that reads S3 date ranges.
Priya: One more: telemetry.events topic should be schema-validated via registry (protobuf). I'll draft proto names and include enums for event_type and fallback_reason.
JonL: Runtime note: avoid blocking path. Producer should be async; if Kafka is unavailable we should buffer to disk and drop oldest events — must not impact request latency.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-producer-service v0.2.0 queued for canary in us-west1 at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z
SaraO: UX question — product wants to expose per-tenant metrics in Console for enterprise. Privacy: only show tenant_hash and aggregated numbers, not tenant raw ids. Also allow opt-in.
EmilyA: Security note: tenant_hash must be HMAC with tenant-specific salt stored in key vault, not plain sha256. Add KMS integration to key rotation docs.
AlexM: Great convo. I'll sync this into the ticket and create a tracking epic. If anyone has objections to sampling rules or retention, raise them here. Otherwise we'll start implementation next sprint. :thumbsup:
